rows.text: A trusted individual or group acts against you: lose Rush
You are separated from something or someone: lose Rush
An individual or group you care about is exposed to danger: lose Rush
A new adversary is revealed: lose Rush
You create an opportunity for an adversary: lose Rush
A Connection or companion is harmed: lose Pulse
Something of value is lost/destroyed: lose Rush
You encounter signs of a looming threat: lose Clarity
You face consequences of an earlier choice: roll again or pick another option
A Connection or companion is put in danger's way: lose Rush
You spend too much/waste money: lose Rush
Your action has an unintended effect: lose Rush
You're frightened or despaired: lose Clarity
Your action violates vampire laws or customs: Try Your Standing next time you slumber
The power you're activating or is active consumes your life force: lose Blood
